scope: All nine mockup packs individually reviewed, portfolio differentiation accepted. This does not certify production commerce or accessibility.

kindred.observed: Occasion/recipient/budget entry, curated gift gallery, countable fixed contents and actual packaging variant. No unsupported note field. Identity correction verified; immutable order rows and totals consistent.
productionDependencies: Typed gift facts and composed server facets
Versioned summit positioning while neutral fallback survives
kindred.followup: Resolved: sign-in email is display text; name editing retained, unsupported email-change promise removed.

madeyours.observed: Process-led choose/specify/review; precise retained invalid text and last valid preview; same-SKU configurations Asha/Kabir separate. Failed Kabir-Rae edit distinguished from accepted Kabir. Immutable order target carries exact accepted configuration; source-backed identity flow verified.
productionDependencies: Cart/checkout binding and immutable order configuration
Merchant fulfillment readback and adversarial/concurrent retry proof
madeyours.followup: Resolved: sign-in email is display text; name editing retained, unsupported email-change promise removed.

playfield.observed: Age/interest activity bento and grouped cards; complete kit count/dimensions; honest unknown age and fictional merchant warnings; real responsive tablet reflow. Current canonical sign-up/Continue correction checked.

pantry.observed: Compact shelf/list shopping, pack-count/net quantity and unknown allergens explicit. Two250g packs=500g at360INR, rice220INR, shipping60INR, final640INR. Immutable order-row correction and mobile summary order verified.

habitat.observed: Room index beside panorama, large object imagery, schematic plus text dimensions. Common assembled facts versus finish-specific package facts distinguished; no date invented. Tablet PDP, mobile summary, canonical identity and immutable order detail reviewed.

dewdrop.observed: Routine-stage independent shelves, named identical-color shades with keyboard proof; ingredients/use adjacency and explicit missing facts. Mobile full summary before payment and read-only sign-in email verified. Current credential branding/source flow aligned.

circuit.observed: Search/task-led hardware catalogue; model distinction, contained photos, comparable units, unknown compatibility, and no unimplemented comparison tray. Current profile and mobile full-summary sequence reviewed.

trailmark.observed: Activity-led equipment mission, category-specific length/weight/grip versus clothing facts; non-safety-critical scope, compatibility unknown. Final summary order and stress corrections verified.

marginalia.observed: Title/author/subject retrieval; narrow intact covers, bibliographic rows, same-title edition/binding distinctions; original excerpt and separate paper facts. Missing ISBN omitted; mobile summary and immutable order reviewed.

portfolio.method: All135 boards reviewed via pack/assembled overviews plus representative full-size critical screens; original neutral task diagrams and actual home/discovery/decision exports compared at equal widths.

pairs.toys_gifts: Adult age/interest and countable activity contents versus occasion/recipient/budget and fixed ready-made gift presentation.
pairs.fashion_sports: Silhouette/fit/garment grid versus activity pathways and equipment-specific measurement model.
pairs.food_beauty: Food pack/net quantity/allergen shopping versus routine-stage independent products and named shade identity.
pairs.electronics_books: Model/connector and normalized technical facts versus author/subject/bibliographic rows and reading path.
pairs.gifts_personalization: Ready-made set selection versus bounded input/validation/review/distinct accepted configurations.

limits: Expert design review, not conversion evidence or merchant usability study.
Synthetic text enlargement and local fixtures are not full assistive-technology/translation certification.
